scope: tracking proposals; thresholds are initial declared choices, not calibrated accuracy claims

atlas_registration.feature_method: OpenCV SIFT full-frame; use frame_alignment matching/RANSAC thresholds, not per-spine identity matching

frame_alignment.identical_image_sha_action: reuse observed track ids, do not create duplicates or claim a sensor failure
frame_alignment.alignment_failure_action: retain new observations as unresolved associations with potential-duplicate review; no title-only merge

association.project_previous_box: transform all four box corners with accepted homography; enclosing axis-aligned pixel box
association.appearance: L1-normalized HSV histogram on the observed spine crop with H8*S8*V8 bins, ranges H0..180/S0..256/V0..256; cv2.HISTCMP_BHATTACHARYYA
association.conflicting_legible_title_action: reject association, preserve both observations and review
association.assignment: sort admissible pairs by descending IoU then ascending histogram distance then existing id/current index; assign one-to-one, never assign one old track to two current proposals
association.ambiguous_action: do not force association; retain uncertain proposal/track with explicit potential-duplicate review

records.identified_requires: legible nonempty title and text_confidence>=0.90 plus legible supporting author or independently sourced catalogue corroboration; otherwise output title/author empty and preserve observed fragments separately
records.publisher_edition_isbn: only supported visible characters/corroborated work metadata with provenance; catalogue listing ISBN is not owned ISBN
records.special_flags: any possible_signed/possible_rare/possible_antiquarian routes needs_appraisal and suppresses automatic valuation
records.art_default: needs_appraisal until clear user-established print assertion
records.count_reporting: recorded/provisional tracks plus unresolved association coverage, never candidate count silently claimed as final physical count

shelves.region_source: visually observed shelving item; known server id and bbox evidence
shelves.book_membership: book center inside supported shelving bbox; smallest containing shelving region if multiple; otherwise unassigned with reason
shelves.unknown_shelf_action: do not invent a shelf name to satisfy a correction
shelves.exclude_region: applies to current and subsequently associated observations, retained as ownership exclusion with user source

state_commit.best_evidence: retain first useful evidence and any later sharper crop using actual Laplacian variance; don't remove prior references
state_commit.inventory_complete: false while unresolved coverage/association remains; final completion requires actual evaluation/reconciliation

required_literal_tests: Same frame repeated produces the same ids and no duplicate count
Two physically separate copies with identical title in one frame remain two tracks
Known image translation and projected boxes preserve original ids
Conflicting legible titles cannot merge merely because boxes overlap
No usable alignment/appearance evidence creates explicit unresolved associations, not a confident title-only merge
User ownership/shelf exclusions and edition/art assertions survive a delayed analysis commit
No dimensions, ISBN, price or total are filled from a model's unsupported proposal
A second independently labelled shelf/continuous sweep is required before generalization or official accuracy claims
